shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: These work anywhere on the table except while typing.
shortcuts.move: Move the selected token one cell

guide.title: How a table works
guide.gmTitle: Your table is ready for its first scene
guide.gmIntro: Three steps and your friends can start playing.
guide.playerIntro: The game master has not shown a scene yet. Here is what you can do meanwhile.

gmScene.title: Create a scene
gmScene.text: A scene is the map everyone sees. Upload an image or start with a blank grid.

gmToken.title: Add tokens
gmToken.text: Tokens are the characters and monsters on the map. Drag them to move them.

gmInvite.title: Invite your players
gmInvite.text: Share an invite link. Friends join from their browser, nothing to install.

playerChat.title: Say hello in the chat
playerChat.text: Type a message, or /r 1d20 to roll dice for everyone to see.

playerMove.title: Move your token
playerMove.text: Drag it on the map, or select it and use the arrow keys.

playerSheet.title: Open your sheet
playerSheet.text: Your character sheet lives in the Sheets tab.

states.notFoundTitle: There is nothing at this address
states.notFoundText: The link may be mistyped or the page may have moved.
states.crashText: Your games are safe. Try again, and reload the page if it keeps happening.
states.worldUnavailableTitle: This world is not available to you
states.worldUnavailableText: It may have been deleted, or you may have been removed from it. Ask the game master for a new invite link.

auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.firstUserHint: The first account created becomes the installation administrator.
auth.welcomeTitle: Your tabletop, wherever your friends are.
auth.welcomeText: Log in, pick a world and start playing. Nothing to install.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

measure.systemHint: Only changes what you see, in this browser.
measure.metersPerFootHint: 0.3 makes 5 ft equal 1.5 m, as most tables do. 0.3048 is the exact value.

validation.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.

worlds.title: Your worlds
worlds.empty: You are not part of any world yet.
worlds.emptyHint: Start your own world below, or ask a game master for an invite link.
worlds.installSystem: Install a rules system package (.zip, admin)

invite.title: Join a world
invite.intro: You were invited to a world. Choose how you appear to the others there.
invite.copyFailedHint: Select the link and copy it by hand.

map.label: Map
map.hint: Drag the background or use the right mouse button to pan, scroll to zoom.
map.videoUnsupported: This browser cannot play the map video, so the map is shown without it.

scene.title: Scenes
scene.name: Name
scene.image: Map image or video (PNG, JPG, WebP, WebM, MP4)
scene.noneHint: Create the first one below. Players see the scene you choose to show them.
scene.mapDataSummary: {{walls}} walls and doors, {{lights}} lights. Only you see them. Click a door's circle on the map to open or close it.
scene.imageSizeFromFile: The scene takes the size of the image.
scene.deleteBody: The scene and its tokens are removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import a map
import.description: Pick a Universal VTT file (.dd2vtt or .uvtt) together with its picture or video, or just a picture or video.
import.filesHint: Select the .dd2vtt and the image or video together (hold Ctrl or Shift).
import.summary: Map {{size}} px, {{lights}} lights, {{walls}} walls and doors found.

warning.no_walls: The file has no walls or doors. In Dungeon Alchemist, export with walls and lighting turned on.
warning.truncated: The file had more walls, doors or lights than OpenVTT keeps; the extra ones were dropped.
warning.size_mismatch: The picture size does not match the grid in the file. Check the cell size below.
warning.grid_guessed: No grid was found in the file name. Set the cell size by hand (for example 28x38 in the name sets it automatically).

error.not_uvtt: That file is not a valid Universal VTT file.
error.bad_grid: The file's grid size is outside what OpenVTT supports.
error.too_large: That file is too large to import.
error.no_media: This file has no picture inside. Select the image or video exported with it as well.
error.unsupported_file: Use a .dd2vtt or .uvtt file, or a PNG, JPG, WebP, WebM or MP4 map.

token.title: Tokens
token.name: Name
token.noneSelected: Select a token on the map.
token.none: No tokens in this scene yet.
token.noneHint: Add one above, then drag it on the map.
token.deleteBody: The token disappears from the map for everyone. This cannot be undone.

sheet.title: Sheets
sheet.noneGm: No sheets yet. Create one below.
sheet.nonePlayer: The game master has not given you a sheet yet.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.deleteBody: The sheet and everything on it is removed. Tokens linked to it stay on the map. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: World settings
settings.templateHelp: Edit the fields of the sheet for the selected type. Computed fields use formulas like floor((@strength - 10) / 2).

errors.invalid_input: Some of the information is invalid.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid.
errors.asset_invalid: That file is not a valid image or video.
errors.roll_invalid: That dice notation is not valid.
errors.template_invalid: That sheet template is not valid.
errors.import_invalid: That file could not be imported.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.video_unsupported: This browser cannot play that video. WebM (VP9) or MP4 (H.264) usually work.
